steps.one: A LangChain deepagents agent running Claude reads your request and the video you sent.
steps.two: It writes a to-do list for the job, and you watch it tick off live.
steps.three: It calls its tools: Auto-Cut finds your best rallies by sound, and Technique Breakdown tracks your pose to check your forehand.
steps.four: It only coaches a real stroke: one inside a rally, right on a ball-contact sound, from your playing stance. Swings after the point ends don't count.
steps.five: Helper agents split the work: a clip analyst, a pro matcher and a coach writer, each with its own notes.
steps.six: Claude writes your reply: what went well, the fix to work on, and a drill, with the videos it made.

breakdown.title: Swing like the pros.
breakdown.body: Drop in a clip of a player you admire and get a step-by-step coaching video of their stroke.
breakdown.needInput: Upload a clip, paste a YouTube link, or describe the player's training instead.
breakdown.videoHint: A few seconds of the stroke. Side-on, full body in frame works best.
breakdown.describe: No video? Describe the training instead
breakdown.trainingPlaceholder: Paste notes, a transcript, or a description of how the player trains this stroke.
breakdown.strokeHint: Pick one to get that stroke's coaching steps, or leave it and we read it from the video.
breakdown.handHint: Auto finds the paddle in the video. Pick a hand if the overlay tracks the wrong arm.
breakdown.beforeCaption: Ma Long repeats a forehand loop in practice, stepping into each swing and returning to his ready stance.

steps.one: We find the few seconds where the swing happens and track the player's body with pose detection, frame by frame.
steps.two: We work out which hand holds the bat and which stroke it is, unless you picked one.
steps.three: We pick the key moments of the swing: the backswing, the contact and the follow-through.
steps.four: AI turns those moments into three short cues, like "Turn waist" or "Brush up", plus a practice drill.
steps.five: We render a vertical coaching video: slow motion into each cue, a freeze frame, and a coloured trail on the bat hand.

match.title: Who do you play like?
match.body: Film yourself hitting a few strokes. We match your height, build and swing to the closest pros and show you their breakdowns.
match.videoHint: Full body in frame, a few forehands or backhands. Side-on with the table visible works best.
match.gripHint: Pros with your grip come first.
match.heightHint: {min}–{max} cm. Leave it empty and we estimate it from the table in the frame (76 cm high, 274 cm long).
match.beforeCaption: A player records their forehand, bending their knees and rotating through the shot.

steps.one: We track your body with pose detection and measure your build: limb lengths compared with your height, and how wide you stand.
steps.two: If you don't give your height, we estimate it from the table in the frame, which is always 76 cm high and 274 cm long.
steps.three: We compare you only with pros who play with the same hand, and pros with your grip come first.
steps.four: The 3 pros closest to your height and build are your matches. We then line up your swing against each of theirs to show where your form differs.
steps.five: You get a score and notes for each pro, plus one video of their technique breakdowns to learn from.
